grid.note: cell key = centre "lat,lon"; values in cm equivalent water height, monthly anomalies

gwsa.name: Groundwater storage anomaly (G3P v1.12)
gwsa.citation: Guentner et al. (2024) Global Gravity-based Groundwater Product (G3P) v1.12, GFZ Data Services, doi:10.5880/G3P.2024.001
gwsa.method: GRACE/GRACE-FO total water storage minus soil moisture, snow, glaciers and surface water (ESA CCI and other products); 250 km Gaussian filter

tws.name: Terrestrial water storage anomaly (GFZ GravIS RL06)
tws.citation: Boergens, Dobslaw & Dill (2019) GFZ GravIS RL06 Continental Water Storage Anomalies, GFZ Data Services, doi:10.5880/GFZ.GRAVIS_06_L3_TWS
tws.method: GRACE (2002-2017) and GRACE-FO (2018-) monthly gravity fields; total of groundwater, soil water, surface water and snow
